Known functional-zone fill colours (other colours still use the general detector):Corridor / AtriumConferenceExecutive SuiteOpen WorkspaceOffice / HuddleCafeteriaServer / High-SecurityR&D / LogisticsVault / Mailroom
Repeated parallel step marks and labelled lavender stairwell compartments are grouped into staircase footprints and recreated as two flights between floors. Pale-green fills and large, light open areas attached to the building edge may be classified as terraces, including areas with dashed or incomplete boundaries. An unmarked white margin cannot always be distinguished from a terrace; review these overlays before conversion.
